deadEnd.details: Submitting the flight search from the homepage lands on an 'Access Blocked - we've detected unusual browsing activity from your network ... complete the CAPTCHA below' page (in an iframe) instead of the results. Not solved.

gotchas: Homepage https://www.singaporeair.com/en_UK/us/home loads cleanly; accept the cookie banner ('Accept'). The calendar follows the browser egress locale (German month names from a European egress).

Search form: origin #flightOrigin1 (name=origin) and destination input[name="destination"] are comboboxes - type a city name and click the option whose name ends with the IATA code (e.g. 'Singapore, Singapore Changi SIN', 'Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia Kuala Lumpur Intl KUL').

Depart date #departDate1 is readonly and opens a calendar; the 'One-way' checkbox inside it is covered by its label, click label[for="oneway_id-default"]. Day cells are li items in ul.calendar_days whose first text is the day number (the price sits in a child); then DONE, then Search.
After Search a 'Try our new booking experience' modal (Try Now / Not Now) can appear.
